name: Handheld Receiver
description: A portable radio receiver device capable of receiving transmissions from other radio stations. It is connected via cable to a portable antenna clamped to a rusted rail on a water tower catwalk. The device receives radio communications from emergency shelters and other stations.
narrative_significance: Critical communication device used by Aria and Noah to establish contact with emergency stations and coordinate relief efforts during a crisis. The successful reception of a distress call from Red Creek station and confirmation from June demonstrates the handheld receiver's essential role in the emergency response network.
